name: Benefitship: The Hallowed Wiener
source:
In this sequel to Benefitship, the story of Amy and Chloe continues as an old friend of Amy's comes back into her life, sparking plenty of sexual tension.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3990010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《Benefitship》的这部续集中，艾米和克洛伊的故事仍在继续，艾米的一位老朋友回到了她的生活中，引发了大量的性紧张。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3990010/]Steam[/url]]
